coach_promise.quote: I'm not here to copy someone, I'm here to do my job, to install my football, the way I see football.
coach_promise.source: Maresca, first press conference as City manager (Yahoo Sports, carrying the club's report)

key_choices.text: Maresca dropped Guardiola's system of players voting for the captain. He chose to appoint the leadership group himself.
He named Rúben Dias, Erling Haaland, Marc Guéhi and Gianluigi Donnarumma as City's four captains for 2026/27.
Maresca left Phil Foden out of the four-man captaincy group. He said Guéhi had been captain at Palace and Donnarumma captains Italy.
After pre-season he said 18-year-old winger Ryan McAidoo would likely stay with the first team this season. He described him as 'the kind of winger I love'.
He said three academy players would be part of his 2026/27 first-team squad, alongside around 20 senior players.

links.text: This is Maresca's third spell at City. He was Elite Development Squad coach (won the PL2 title in 2020/21), then Guardiola's assistant from June 2022, and is now head coach. He left Chelsea on 1 January 2026.

Chelsea said Maresca asked to leave mid-contract after being told of the City opportunity. Maresca said he 'unexpectedly and abruptly resigned' in December 2025, and that this was neither his intention nor his wish. Chelsea have since appointed Xabi Alonso, who was replaced at Real Madrid by Fulham's Arbeloa.

teams.replaced_reason: Silva left Fulham at the end of his contract to take charge of Benfica, after five years at the club (Yahoo Sports; beIN Sports).

institution_quote.quote: I loved hearing that from Álvaro, as well as his intent on playing attacking football.
institution_quote.speaker: Shahid Khan, Fulham owner
institution_quote.source: Fulham FC official site, 'Álvaro Arbeloa appointed Fulham Head Coach'

coach_promise.quote: We want to be a really offensive team, really brave with the ball, and aggressive when we lose it, and ready to attack.
coach_promise.source: Arbeloa, as quoted by CoachNotes (a blog; the date and occasion of the quote are not given, and it may not be from his presentation). His official appointment statement said 'I am sure we are going to enjoy an incredible journey together'.

key_choices.text: In his first league game, a 3-2 home defeat to Chelsea, Arbeloa said Fulham would keep pressing high and playing in the opponent's half 'no matter who is in front of us'.
After the Crystal Palace defeat he shifted towards a more balanced approach on transitions. Fulham then drew 0-0 at Liverpool.
Arbeloa calls Calvin Bassey 'one of my captains'. Bassey also wore the armband in Fulham's last two pre-season games.
Arbeloa has backed younger attackers such as Bobb, Josh King and Gonzalo García, rather than the experienced forwards Fulham leaned on last season.

links.text: Arbeloa took over Real Madrid's first team in January 2026 after Xabi Alonso left. Alonso is now Chelsea manager, and Arbeloa's Fulham opened the season against him.

reviews.headline: Anderson steps up, Berge impresses - player ratings for Man City v Fulham
reviews.quote: Elliot Anderson's stunning second-half volley rescued a point against Fulham, but Manchester City extend their winless run to four games in the Premier League.
reviews.point: Anderson was City's best player and his equalising volley saved a point, but the draw extended City's winless league run to four games.
